content: Bismuth subsalicylate is an over-the-counter antacid that has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of diarrhea, heartburn, indigestion, nausea, and upset stomach. Common side effects include temporary darkening of the stool and/or tongue. For adults and children aged 12 years and older, the recommended dosage is 2 tablets every 30 minutes to 1 hour as needed. The maximum allowable dosage is 8 doses (16 tablets) within a 24-hour period. Children under 12 years of age should consult a doctor before use. It is advised to drink plenty of fluids to prevent dehydration, which may occur with diarrhea. Each tablet contains less than 1 mg of sodium, 102 mg of salicylate, and 140 mg of calcium. The product should be stored away from excessive heat (above 104°F or 40°C). Do not use the product if the tamper-evident packaging is damaged. Bismuth subsalicylate should not be used by children or teenagers recovering from chickenpox or flu-like symptoms due to the risk of Reye's syndrome, a rare but serious condition. If behavioral changes, nausea, or vomiting occur, a doctor should be consulted immediately. The product contains salicylate and should not be used by individuals allergic to salicylates (including aspirin) or those taking other salicylate-containing products. It is contraindicated in individuals with bloody or black stools, ulcers, or bleeding disorders. Consult a doctor before use if you have a fever or mucus in the stool. Additionally, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are taking medications for blood thinning, diabetes, gout, or arthritis. Temporary darkening of the stool or tongue may occur during use, but this is harmless. Discontinue use and seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, if ringing in the ears or hearing loss occurs, or if diarrhea persists for more than 2 days. Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should consult a healthcare professional before use. In case of overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact a Poison Control Center. The active ingredient in each tablet is bismuth subsalicylate (262 mg), which includes 102 mg of salicylate. Other ingredients include calcium carbonate, D&C Red 27 aluminum lake, flavoring agents, magnesium stearate, mannitol, pregelatinized starch, and saccharin sodium. The product should be stored in a cool, dry place and protected from excessive heat. There is limited information available regarding the use of bismuth subsalicylate in specific populations, including pregnant or nursing individuals, pediatric patients under 12 years, geriatric patients, and those with renal or hepatic impairment. There is also no established guidance on its use in immunocompromised patients or specific racial or gender populations. The interaction between alcohol and bismuth subsalicylate has not been established, so patients should consult their doctor regarding alcohol consumption while using this medication. The product is marketed under the brand name Bismatrol®.
